name: Scaled Disciple — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Scaled Disciple from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Scaled Disciple (Kobold)" but are not part of the Scaled Disciple entry, which is unchanged.

Editor’s Note

The author of this feat has pointed out that he made a mistake, and that this feat should apply to spells included in the Scalykind domain or its subdomains (which includes the Dragon subdomain).

The list of spells that this includes is as follows:

1st—magic fang
2nd—animal trance
3rd—greater magic fang, draconic reservoir
4th—poison, dragon’s breath, summon nature’s ally IV (deinonychus or pteranodon only)

8th—animal shapes*
9th—shapechange

* Includes only viper and constrictor snakes

Note that spontaneous divine casters may not actually have any way to access some of these spells. Players and GMs are encouraged to use this new information in their games.

Source
